name: nvim
description: Private Codex plugin for Neovim issue investigation, planning, worktree, verification, and review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Neovim issue, repro, planning, verification, review, and edit-window workflows
interface.longDescription: Private Neovim workflows for Codex sessions: fetch GitHub issue context with gh, create isolated upstream worktrees, run history investigation, run bounded rbuild reproduction as a separate stage, choose among realistic outcomes before implementation, verify changes, review local patch state, and populate mux Neovim windows for editing/review.
defaultPrompt: Investigate Neovim issue #12345 without proposing fixes
Reproduce Neovim issue #12345 with the configured rbuild strategy
Plan realistic outcomes for Neovim issue #12345 before editing
Verify the implementation work for Neovim issue #12345
Review the implementation patch for Neovim issue #12345
Create a Neovim issue worktree and write the report
Populate the edit window with the relevant mux command files
